222-527-2511-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-2146-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-2146-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2511-4186-6566--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7825.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

3188-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3188-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

4091-5709-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
4091-5709-7791.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Rofellos.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Rofellos.
Repeat.

215-1115-1376.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1115-1376.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-1526-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-4785.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5231-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
5231-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-5256-5434-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

703-2897-7149.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Gigantoplasm dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Gigantoplasm enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Gigantoplasms into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Gigantoplasm tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-2897-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

1305-4742-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

628-6797-7211.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

2060-4770-6930-6967.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

407-2816-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Swamps.
407-2816-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Umbral Mantle attached using Cabal Coffers's ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate the creature by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3174-4050-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1315-2783-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-5457-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with different powers.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Selvala and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5457-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
314-6191.description:
Gain life.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

372-2493-3556.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker.
372-2493-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2034-5258-5553-5618.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, adding {C}{C}.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Greedy Freedbooter from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

3869-4067-5457.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four creatures with different powers.
3869-4067-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.n: Byrke, Long Ear of the Law

2060-3398-5854.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least seven +1/+1 counters on it.
Crystalline Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Crystalline Crawler and Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-3398-5854.description:
Declare Crystalline Crawler and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Byrke's second ability and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Byrke trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Crystalline Crawler has at least eight +1/+1 counters on it, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counter doubling.

1637-3946-4426.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

575-2292-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-2292-4319-5441.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Granite Witness
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

1525-1636-4488-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1525-1636-4488-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Rampaging Baloths triggers for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the first Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3 for any remaining trigger(s), if needed.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

855-3693-4120.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
855-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
855-3693-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

413-2459-3184.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Yomiji triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1191-2577-4474-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Merrow Bonegnawer.
Merrow Bonegnawer does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
1191-2577-4474-5256.description:
Activate Merrow Bonegnawer by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing target player to mill cards equal to Gravecrawler's power.
Cast Gravecrawler by paying {B}.
Merrow Bonegnawer triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2034-3604-4891-5220.description:
Cast Atsushi by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Atsushi enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Atsushi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Atsushi dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them until the end of your next turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Atsushi dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

225-539-907-1993.notablePrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
225-539-907-1993.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
